patient.text:
SYNTHETIC NOTE - NOT A REAL PATIENT
Note date: 2026-09-18

Chief complaint: Follow-up for newly diagnosed lung cancer.

History of present illness: 62-year-old woman, former smoker (30 pack-years, quit in 2015), who presented in July 2026 with persistent cough and 6 kg weight loss. CT chest showed a 4.2 cm right upper lobe mass with mediastinal lymphadenopathy. CT-guided biopsy on 2026-08-04 confirmed lung adenocarcinoma. PET-CT on 2026-08-12 showed bilateral adrenal metastases; stage IV disease. Brain MRI on 2026-08-14 showed no intracranial metastases. Molecular testing: EGFR exon 19 deletion detected; ALK and ROS1 negative. PD-L1 TPS 10%. She has not yet received any systemic therapy for lung cancer.

Past medical history: Hypertension, well controlled on lisinopril. Type 2 diabetes mellitus on metformin, HbA1c 7.1% in August 2026. Left breast ductal carcinoma in situ treated with lumpectomy and radiation in 2014, no recurrence. She denies any history of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.

Family history: Mother died of breast cancer at age 71. Father had a myocardial infarction at age 65.

Medications: Lisinopril 10 mg daily, metformin 1000 mg twice daily.

Examination: ECOG performance status 1. Blood pressure 128/76 mmHg, heart rate 82, SpO2 96% on room air. Decreased breath sounds at the right apex.

Laboratory results (2026-09-15): Hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL, absolute neutrophil count 3.4 x 10^9/L, platelets 245 x 10^9/L. Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL. ALT 28 U/L, AST 31 U/L, total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL. ECG on 2026-09-15: normal sinus rhythm, QTc 438 ms.

Assessment and plan: Stage IV EGFR-mutated lung adenocarcinoma, treatment-naive. Discussed first-line options including clinical trial participation.

trial.title: Additional Chemotherapy for EGFRm Patients with the Continued Presence of Plasma CtDNA EGFRm At Week 3 After Start of Osimertinib 1st-line Treatment (PACE-LUNG)
trial.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

Pre-Screening Phase

1. Provision of written informed consent for the pre-screening phase.
2. Age ≥ 18 years
3. Histologically confirmed stage IIIB or IV NSCLC
4. Tumor positive for Ex19del or L858R EGFR mutation assessed according to local standard.
5. Planned treatment with osimertinib 80mg/d 1st-line as SoC or ongoing treatment for a maximum of 28 days
6. Available radiographic chest and abdominal CT or MRI scans performed up to 42 days before initial osimertinib treatment
7. Previously untreated with systemic treatment given as primary therapy for advanced or metastatic disease, except for osimertinib for a maximum of 28 days (see above)
8. At least one measurable site of disease as defined by RECISTv1.1 criteria
9. Female subjects of childbearing potential (WOCBP) should be using highly effective contraceptive measures and must have a negative urine or serum pregnancy test within 7 days prior to start of study treatment and must not be breast-feeding prior to start of trial. Further information in Appendix 20.7 (Definition of Women of Childbearing Potential and Acceptable Contraceptive Methods)
10. Non-child-bearing potential must be evidenced by fulfilling one of the following criteria at screening:

    * Post-menopausal defined as aged more than 50 years and amenorrheic for at least 12 months following cessation of all exogenous hormonal treatments
    * Women under 50 years old would be considered postmenopausal if they have been amenorrheic for 12 months or more following cessation of exogenous hormonal treatments and with LH and FSH levels in the post-menopausal range for the institution.
    * Documentation of irreversible surgical sterilisation by hysterectomy, bilateral oophorectomy or bilateral salpingectomy but not tubal ligation

Treatment Phase

1. Provision of informed consent for the screening and treatment phase prior to any study specific procedures, including screening evaluations that are not SoC.
2. Persistent mEGFR ctDNA signal 21 to 28 days after osimertinib initiation for advanced of metastatic ex19del or L858R EGFR mutation positive NSCLC as assessed by a liquid biopsy during the pre-screening phase of the trial in the central laboratory.
3. ECOG performance status 0-2.
4. The patient is willing and able to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study, including hospital visits for treatment and scheduled follow-up visits and examinations.
5. Osimertinib no longer than 10 weeks before start of chemotherapy in the treatment phase

Exclusion Criteria:

Pre-Screening Phase

1. History of another primary malignancy. Exceptions are:

   * Malignancy treated with curative intent and with no known active disease ≥6 months before the first dose of IMP, and of low potential risk for recurrence
   * Adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer or lentigo maligna without evidence of disease
   * Adequately treated carcinoma in situ without evidence of disease
2. History of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis
3. Concurrent enrolment in another clinical study, unless it is an observational (non-interventional) clinical study, or during the follow-up period of an interventional study
4. Previous enrolment in the present study.

Treatment Phase

1. Symptomatic CNS metastases. \[Patients with asymptomatic brain metastases may be included.\]
2. History of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis
3. Currently receiving (or unable to stop use prior to receiving the first dose of study treatment) medications or herbal supplements known to be strong inducers of CYP3A4 (at least 3 weeks prior) (Appendix 20.5). All patients must try to avoid concomitant use of any medications, herbal supplements and/or ingestion of foods with known inducer effects on CYP3A4.
4. Osimertinib had to be withheld or administered at reduced dosage for toxicity management for more than 7 days or persistent unresolved toxicities which preclude study treatment.
5. Any unresolved toxicities other than osimertinib from prior therapy greater than CTCAE grade 1 at the time of starting study treatment, with the exception of alopecia and grade 2 prior platinum-therapy-related neuropathy.
6. History of hypersensitivity to active or inactive excipients of osimertinib or drugs with a similar chemical structure or class to osimertinib. History of hypersensitivity to any of the chemotherapy drugs used.
7. Any evidence of severe or uncontrolled systemic diseases, including uncontrolled hypertension and active bleeding diatheses, which in the investigator's opinion makes it undesirable for the patient to participate in the trial or which would jeopardize compliance with the protocol, or active infection including hepatitis B, hepatitis C and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). Screening for chronic conditions is not required.
8. Refractory nausea and vomiting, chronic gastrointestinal diseases, inability to swallow the formulated product or previous significant bowel resection that would preclude adequate absorption of osimertinib.
9. Any of the following cardiac criteria:

   1. Mean resting corrected QT interval (QTc) \> 470 msec obtained from 3 electrocardiograms (ECGs), using the screening clinic ECG machine derived QTc value
   2. Any clinically important abnormalities in rhythm, conduction or morphology of resting ECG e.g. complete left bundle branch block, third degree heart block and second degree heart block.
   3. Patient with any factors that increase the risk of QTc prolongation or risk of arrhythmic events such as heart failure, electrolyte abnormalities (including: Serum/plasma potassium \< LLN; Serum/plasma magnesium \< LLN; Serum/plasma calcium \< LLN), congenital long QT syndrome, family history of long QT syndrome or unexplained sudden death under 40 years of age in first degree relatives or any concomitant medication known to prolong the QT interval and cause Torsades de Pointes. \[Note: Electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalaemia, hypomagnesaemia, hypocalcaemia) can be corrected to be within normal ranges prior to first dose. No more than two re-tests may be performed in order to meet this criterion.\]
10. Past medical history of interstitial lung disease, drug-induced interstitial lung disease, radiation pneumonitis which required steroid treatment, or any evidence of clinically active interstitial lung disease.
11. Inadequate bone marrow reserve or organ function as demonstrated by any of the following laboratory values:

    1. Absolute neutrophil count below lower limit of normal (\<LLN) \*
    2. Platelet count below lower limit of normal (\<LLN) \*
    3. Hemoglobin \<90 g/L \*

       \* The use of granulocyte colony stimulating factor support, platelet transfusion and blood transfusions to meet these criteria is not permitted.
    4. Alanine aminotransferase \>2.5 times ULN if no demonstrable liver metastases or \>5 times ULN in the presence of liver metastases;
    5. Aspartate aminotransferase \>2.5 times ULN if no demonstrable liver metastases or \>5 times ULN in the presence of liver metastases;
    6. Total bilirubin \>1.5 times ULN if no liver metastases or \>3 times ULN in the presence of documented Gilbert's Syndrome \[unconjugated hyperbilirubinaemia\] or liver metastases;
    7. Serum creatinine \>1.5 times ULN concurrent with creatinine clearance \<60 mL/min \[calculated by Cockcroft and Gault equation\]-confirmation of creatinine clearance is only required when creatinine is \>1.5 times ULN.
    8. INR ≤ 1.4 or aPTT ≤ 40 sec during the last 7 days before chemotherapy \[Subjects under therapeutic anticoagulation are permitted.\]
12. Judgement by the investigator that the patient should not participate in the study if the patient is unlikely to comply with study procedures, restrictions and requirements.
13. Women who are pregnant or breast-feeding
14. Male or female patients of reproductive potential who are not willing to employ effective birth control from screening to 4 months (male patients) or 6 weeks (female patients) after the last dose of osimertinib and 6 months after the last dose of chemotherapy.
15. Patients who are unable to consent because they do not understand the nature, significance and implications of the clinical trial and therefore cannot form a rational intention in the light of the facts \[§ 40 Abs. 1 S. 3 Nr. 3a AMG\].
16. Treatment with an investigational drug within five half-lives of the compound or 3 months, whichever is greater.
17. Any chemotherapy, biologic, or hormonal therapy for cancer treatment used concurrently or within 6 months prior to first dose of study treatment. Concurrent use of hormonal therapy for non-cancer-related conditions (e.g., hormone replacement therapy) is acceptable.
18. Major surgery (as defined by the Investigator) within 4 weeks prior to starting the study; patients must have recovered from effects of preceding major surgery. Note: Local non-major surgery for palliative intent (e.g., surgery of isolated lesions) is acceptable

key_reasons.text: Meets inclusion criterion: The patient is at least 18 years old. (The patient is 62 years old, which is at least 18 years.)

Meets inclusion criterion: The patient has histologically confirmed stage IIIB or stage IV non-small cell lung cancer. (The biopsy confirmed lung adenocarcinoma, a non-small cell lung cancer, and the disease is stage IV.)
Meets inclusion criterion: The patient's tumor is positive for an EGFR Ex19del or L858R mutation, assessed according to local standard. (Molecular testing detected an EGFR exon 19 deletion.)

Meets inclusion criterion: The patient has not previously received systemic treatment as primary therapy for advanced or metastatic disease, except for osimertinib for a maximum of 28 days. (The note explicitly states that she has not received prior systemic therapy for her lung cancer.)
Meets inclusion criterion: The patient's ECOG performance status is 0-2. (The documented ECOG performance status of 1 is within the required range of 0 through 2.)

follow_up.text: Check inclusion criterion "The patient has planned first-line treatment with osimertinib 80mg/d as standard of care or is receiving ongoing osimertinib treatment for a maximum of 28 days.": Whether first-line osimertinib is planned at 80 mg/day or has started, including the osimertinib start date and dose. Already established: No systemic therapy has started.

Check inclusion criterion "Radiographic chest and abdominal CT or MRI scans are available and were performed up to 42 days before initial osimertinib treatment.": Whether abdominal CT or MRI is available, the date of the chest imaging, and the date of initial osimertinib treatment to assess the 42-day window. Already established: Chest CT was performed.

Check inclusion criterion "A female patient of childbearing potential has a negative urine or serum pregnancy test.": Determine childbearing potential and obtain a negative urine or serum pregnancy test within 7 days before study treatment if applicable. Already established: Female sex is documented, but childbearing potential and pregnancy testing are not documented.

Check inclusion criterion "A female patient of childbearing potential is not breast-feeding.": Determine childbearing potential and confirm that she is not breastfeeding before trial start if applicable. Already established: Female sex is documented, but childbearing potential and breastfeeding status are not documented.

Check inclusion criterion "At screening, the patient has non-child-bearing potential evidenced by one of the specified criteria: post-menopausal status defined by age over 50 years and amenorrhea for at least 12 months after cessation of all exogenous hormonal treatments; for women under 50 years, amenorrhea for at least 12 months after cessation of exogenous hormonal treatments with LH and FSH levels in the institution's post-menopausal range; or documented irreversible surgical sterilization by hysterectomy, bilateral oophorectomy, or bilateral salpingectomy, but not tubal ligation.": Document at least 12 months of amenorrhea after cessation of exogenous hormones, or qualifying irreversible surgical sterilization; obtain LH/FSH only if the under-50 pathway applies. Already established: Age over 50 years is documented; amenorrhea, cessation of exogenous hormones, post-menopausal laboratory results, and qualifying surgical sterilization are not documented.

Check inclusion criterion "The patient has a persistent EGFR-mutated ctDNA signal 21 to 28 days after osimertinib initiation for advanced or metastatic Ex19del- or L858R-positive non-small cell lung cancer, assessed by liquid biopsy in the central laboratory during the pre-screening phase.": Start osimertinib if appropriate, then obtain the central-laboratory liquid biopsy 21 to 28 days after initiation to assess persistent EGFR-mutated ctDNA. Already established: EGFR exon 19 deletion and stage IV metastatic lung adenocarcinoma are documented, but osimertinib initiation and post-initiation ctDNA persistence are not documented.

Check inclusion criterion "The patient started osimertinib no longer than 10 weeks before the start of chemotherapy in the treatment phase.": Confirm the osimertinib start date and the planned chemotherapy start date after treatment begins. Already established: Osimertinib or other systemic therapy has not started.
Check exclusion criterion "The patient has a history of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.": Ask about or review the patient's history for leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient is concurrently enrolled in another clinical study, unless it is an observational non-interventional clinical study, or is in the follow-up period of an interventional study.": Confirm whether the patient is concurrently enrolled in another clinical study or is in a permitted follow-up period.
Check exclusion criterion "The patient was previously enrolled in the present study.": Confirm whether the patient was previously enrolled in NCT05281406.
Check exclusion criterion "The patient has a history of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.": Ask about or review the patient's history for leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient is currently receiving, or cannot stop before the first dose of study treatment, medications or herbal supplements known to be strong inducers of CYP3A4.": Verify all current prescription, over-the-counter, herbal, and dietary products and determine whether any are strong CYP3A4 inducers or can be stopped at least 3 weeks before study treatment.

Check exclusion criterion "Osimertinib had to be withheld or administered at a reduced dosage for toxicity management for more than 7 days, or the patient has persistent unresolved toxicities that preclude study treatment.": Determine whether osimertinib was later withheld or dose-reduced for toxicity for more than 7 days, or whether persistent unresolved toxicities preclude treatment. Already established: Osimertinib has not yet been started.

Check exclusion criterion "At the time of starting study treatment, the patient has any unresolved toxicity other than osimertinib-related toxicity from prior therapy greater than CTCAE grade 1, except alopecia and grade 2 prior platinum-therapy-related neuropathy.": At the time of starting study treatment, assess whether any unresolved toxicity from prior therapy is greater than CTCAE grade 1, excluding the listed exceptions. Already established: No prior systemic therapy for lung cancer.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has a history of hypersensitivity to active or inactive excipients of osimertinib, drugs with a similar chemical structure or class to osimertinib, or any chemotherapy drugs used.": Ask or review records for hypersensitivity to osimertinib, its excipients, chemically similar drugs, or planned chemotherapy drugs.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has refractory nausea and vomiting, chronic gastrointestinal disease, inability to swallow the formulated product, or previous significant bowel resection that would preclude adequate absorption of osimertinib.": Ask about refractory nausea or vomiting, chronic gastrointestinal disease, ability to swallow the formulated product, and significant bowel resection affecting osimertinib absorption.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient's mean resting corrected QT interval is greater than 470 msec, obtained from 3 electrocardiograms using the screening clinic ECG machine-derived QTc value.": Obtain the mean resting QTc from 3 screening ECGs using the screening clinic ECG machine-derived values. Already established: One ECG showed QTc 438 ms.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient's resting ECG has a clinically important abnormality in rhythm, conduction, or morphology, such as complete left bundle branch block, third-degree heart block, or second-degree heart block.": Review the resting ECG for clinically important conduction or morphological abnormalities, including bundle branch block or heart block. Already established: Normal sinus rhythm documented.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has a factor that increases the risk of QTc prolongation or arrhythmic events, including heart failure, electrolyte abnormality, congenital long QT syndrome, a family history of long QT syndrome, unexplained sudden death before age 40 in a first-degree relative, or concomitant medication known to prolong the QT interval and cause Torsades de Pointes; electrolyte abnormalities may be corrected to normal before the first dose with no more than two retests.": Assess for heart failure, electrolyte abnormalities, congenital or family long QT syndrome, unexplained sudden death before age 40 in a first-degree relative, and QT-prolonging medications causing Torsades de Pointes before first dose.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient's serum creatinine is greater than 1.5 times ULN concurrently with creatinine clearance below 60 mL/min calculated by the Cockcroft and Gault equation; creatinine clearance confirmation is required only when serum creatinine is greater than 1.5 times ULN.": Confirm the laboratory ULN for serum creatinine and obtain creatinine clearance calculated by the Cockcroft and Gault equation if the creatinine is greater than 1.5 times that ULN. Already established: Serum creatinine documented as 0.9 mg/dL.

Check exclusion criterion "During the last 7 days before chemotherapy, the patient's INR is 1.4 or less or the patient's aPTT is 40 seconds or less; subjects under therapeutic anticoagulation are permitted.": INR and/or aPTT measured during the 7 days before chemotherapy, including whether the patient is under therapeutic anticoagulation.
Check exclusion criterion "The patient is pregnant or breast-feeding.": Whether the patient is pregnant or breast-feeding.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient received treatment with an investigational drug within five half-lives of the compound or 3 months, whichever is greater.": Any investigational drug exposure and the date of the last dose, together with the relevant compound half-life if applicable.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has received or is concurrently receiving chemotherapy, biologic therapy, or hormonal therapy for cancer treatment, except that concurrent hormonal therapy for non-cancer-related conditions such as hormone replacement therapy is acceptable.": Any chemotherapy, biologic therapy, or hormonal therapy for cancer treatment, including treatment for cancers other than lung cancer, during the 6 months before the first study-treatment dose or concurrently. Already established: No systemic therapy for lung cancer is documented.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient underwent major surgery, as defined by the investigator, within 4 weeks before starting the study and has not recovered from its effects; local non-major surgery for palliative intent, such as surgery of isolated lesions, is acceptable.": Whether the patient underwent any major surgery within 4 weeks before starting the study and, if so, whether she recovered from it. Already established: Left breast lumpectomy and radiation occurred in 2014.

confirm_at_screening.text: Confirm at screening "The patient provides written informed consent for the pre-screening phase.": Whether the patient provided written informed consent for the pre-screening phase.

Confirm at screening "A female patient of childbearing potential is using highly effective contraceptive measures.": Determine whether she has childbearing potential and, if so, document use of highly effective contraception before study treatment. Already established: Female sex is documented, but childbearing potential and contraceptive use are not documented.

Confirm at screening "The patient provides informed consent for the screening and treatment phase before any study-specific procedures, including screening evaluations that are not standard of care.": Document informed consent before any study-specific screening or treatment procedures.

Confirm at screening "The patient is willing and able to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study, including hospital visits for treatment and scheduled follow-up visits and examinations.": Confirm willingness and ability to comply with study visits, treatment, follow-up examinations, and the protocol for the full study duration.

Confirm at screening "The patient has severe or uncontrolled systemic disease, including uncontrolled hypertension or active bleeding diathesis, or active infection including hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV, that in the investigator's opinion makes participation undesirable or would jeopardize protocol compliance.": Assess for other severe or uncontrolled systemic disease and active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV infection, plus investigator judgment regarding participation and protocol compliance. Already established: Hypertension is described as well controlled.

Confirm at screening "The investigator judges that the patient should not participate because the patient is unlikely to comply with study procedures, restrictions, or requirements.": Investigator assessment of the patient's ability and willingness to comply with study procedures, restrictions, and requirements.

Confirm at screening "A male or female patient of reproductive potential is not willing to employ effective birth control for the specified period after treatment.": Whether the patient is of reproductive potential and, if so, whether she is willing to use effective birth control for the specified period.

Confirm at screening "The patient is unable to consent because they do not understand the nature, significance, and implications of the clinical trial and therefore cannot form a rational intention in light of the facts.": Assessment of the patient's understanding of the trial and ability to provide informed consent.
